Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the seated woman and the kneeling woman both completely visible from their feet to the top of their heads, with the stone walls, the vaulted ceiling and the flagstone floor around them at normal human scale. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
